text: I was hurt in a car accident in Newcastle. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

result.keyword: I was hurt in a car accident in Newcastle. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?
result.markdown:
If your accident happened in **Newcastle, NSW**, you’ll generally be dealing with the NSW **CTP (Compulsory Third Party) scheme**. SIRA says you may be entitled to treatment/care, income support and potentially a lump-sum payment, depending on your circumstances. [www.sira.nsw.gov.au](https://www.sira.nsw.gov.au/motor?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I’d consider contacting **2–3 firms for an initial assessment**, rather than choosing solely on reviews:

- Burke Mead Lawyers - Newcastle — Newcastle CBD; personal-injury specialist.
- Andrew John Carr Solicitors — Newcastle CBD.
- Walker Law Group — Newcastle West; personal-injury practice.
- Law Partners Injury Lawyers Newcastle — Hunter Street; personal-injury specialist.
- Slater and Gordon Lawyers — Newcastle CBD; established personal-injury firm.
- Whitelaw McDonald Personal Injury Lawyers - Newcastle — Kotara; personal-injury specialist.
- Turner Freeman Lawyers Newcastle — Newcastle CBD; personal-injury practice.

### One important deadline

SIRA currently says a motor-crash claim should generally be made **within 3 months of the crash**, and if you want loss-of-earnings back-pay from the day after the accident, the relevant timeframe is **28 days**. It's therefore worth contacting a lawyer promptly even if you're still recovering. [www.sira.nsw.gov.au](https://www.sira.nsw.gov.au/resources-library/motor-accident-resources/publications/injury-advice-centre/guide-for-people-injured-in-motor-accidents-in-nsw?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

You can also get **free, confidential legal advice** through SIRA's CTP Legal Advisory Service. Call **CTP Assist on 1300 656 919**; they'll check eligibility and arrange a consultation with a lawyer. [www.sira.nsw.gov.au](https://www.sira.nsw.gov.au/resources-library/motor-crash-compensation/guides-and-resources/ctp-legal-advisory-service?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

When you call a firm, tell them:
- accident date and location
- whether you were the driver, passenger, cyclist or pedestrian
- your injuries and treatment so far
- whether another driver was at fault
- whether you've already lodged a CTP claim
- whether you've had time off work or lost income.

**If you tell me roughly when the accident happened, whether you were at fault, and what your main injuries are, I can narrow this down to the most relevant Newcastle lawyers and explain what type of compensation you may be able to pursue.**
